title: The Slow Postcards
author: Ulyana Vane
blurb: Noor Coldharbour, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
